claims.title: Inverse growth: metric restrictions, global reach and a clear graph formation path

quoted_fields.interface: Omega convex in R2, f C2 with global operator Hessian bound M, y_t(x)=(x,t f(x)), 0<=t<=1, upward normal n_t and |z|<=a with aM<1. Credited thin Kirchhoff--Love/StVenant--Kirchhoff bilayer inverse assumes independently orthotropic equal-thickness layers and sufficiently small thickness.
quoted_fields.failure: The new graph theorem excludes arbitrary topology and folded helicoids. The prior local positive-metric construction alone does not ensure global thickness reach. Isotropic layers retain their restricted curvature obstruction. Actual metric writing, stable physical tracking, load, finite-thickness error, energy, renewal and observation are unconstructed. The prior held Jones--Mahadevan identity is not recovered.
